note: Aitkin County park on the Mississippi River in Palisade (510 Marconi St), within walking distance of town. Sites line Marconi Street, back from the river; the park has a fishing pier, boat access, picnic shelter and a play area. The Soo Line ATV/snowmobile trail runs through the park and there is an ATV wash station. Water is on from about the first week of May to the last week of October. --Claude
summary: County page + OneGov read: $30 (dump $5), 9 sites all with 50/30/20A electric, flush toilets, showers, water, dump; online booking closes 7 days out, then first-come at a self-pay kiosk (platform operator via OneGov). Not waterfront kept. Website domain moved; second link is dead. No season stated.

OHV side (flag only): the county's 2017 photo tour opens 'Welcome to Berglund Park - kid friendly and ATV trail accessible', with 'North Soo Line ATV trail - accessible from the park' and an ATV wash station. It is a general town-edge county park (play area, fishing pier, pavilion, walking trails), not an ATV staging camp; reviewer to judge.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. The county map puts sites 1-9 as angled spurs off a road along Marconi Street, with the river beyond the open park lawn, pavilion and fishing pier; stored evidence puts the pads about 150 m back behind a wooded buffer.
Pin 46.71030,-93.48590 is about 70 m from the county GPS (46 42'36"N 93 29'12"W = 46.71000,-93.48667); no move needed.

Season: not stated for the campground. The county says water at Aitkin and Berglund 'is turned on in the first week of May and turned off the last week of October (weather/temperature dependent)' and 'Snow is not plowed at any campgrounds'; season left absent.
